calculation.description: Fade each asset's beta-adjusted idiosyncratic daily return shock, with greater reversal strength when the tradable US10Y/CN10Y log-yield spread has an extreme five-day move. Cross-sectional median returns define the market proxy. US10Y and CN10Y are tradable benchmark series and are used only as regime inputs here.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive in 2020-2022 (0.060465, 592 observations), 2023-2024 (0.057006, 410), and 2025-2027 (0.027525, 491). The 10-day ICIR falls below the daily gate, so this is primarily a daily/short-horizon component.
